facts.fact: The Minister of Basic and Secondary Education says an early warning system on DHIS2 continuously monitors each student's attendance and academic performance and sorts learners by drop-out risk; she does not say who enters the data, and the speech is undated, so the article's published date is used.
The minister describes the DHIS2 early warning system as in operation and gives no number or share of schools using it; dated to the article's publication.
The minister presents the early warning system as the ministry's own and says plans are under way to integrate it with the health data system; dated to the article's publication.

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education
systems.tiers: learners' attendance and academic performance; tiers not stated

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education

note: The minister says the ministry is expanding 'IMIS' without saying what it holds; the planned link to health data is an exchange item, not yet made.
